== Biography ==
'''Orena Glasgow''' was born about 1845 in Canada. The estimate comes from her age of seven at next birthday in the 1851 census.<ref name="Census1851">Library and Archives Canada, [https://central.bac-lac.gc.ca/.item/?app=Census1851&op=img&id=e002351566 1851 Census of Canada West, Prescott, page 31, lines 11–18, image e002351566], original schedule (accessed 13 August 2026).</ref>

She appeared in the Prescott household of [[Glasgow-4010|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-764031|Mary E. Glasgow]]. The census does not explicitly state kinship, so both parent relationships are marked uncertain.

Orena's rare name and compatible age recur in a transcription of the 1861 Prescott grammar-school census, where she was associated with Samuel Glasgow, storekeeper.<ref>[https://thepastaroundus.wordpress.com/2015/10/12/black-walnuts-squirrels-and-prescott-high-school/ “Black Walnuts, Squirrels and Prescott High School,” ''The Past Around Us''], 1861 entry for Orena Glasgow, aged 17 (accessed 13 August 2026).</ref>
